discharge_note_dem: catchmentAreaKm2Dem comes from D8 flow accumulation on this domain's 30 m DEM and is TRUNCATED wherever the basin extends past the domain boundary (catchmentTruncatedByDomain). catchmentAreaKm2 is the published/estimated full basin area and is what the discharge uses.
discharge_note: monsoon_discharge_m3s = catchmentAreaKm2 (from D8 flow accumulation on the 30 m DEM) × a late-August specific-runoff coefficient (Tibetan rain-shadow 0.030–0.033, Nepali monsoon flank 0.075–0.090 m³/s/km²). These are order-of-magnitude engineering estimates for a visualisation, NOT gauged discharges.
